claims.text: The Resident Manager can arrange surprises such as proposals and anniversary or birthday celebrations, plus babysitting and pet-sitting services.

claims.text: Hotel 41's lounge and dining room is exclusively for in-house guests; for more dining options, guests use the two restaurants at the adjoining sister hotel, The Rubens at the Palace.

findings.quote: a historic lounge and dining room - exclusively for in-house guests
For more dining options, The Rubens adjoins Hotel 41 which is connected via a concealed door.
The Rubens offers two gourmet restaurants and a happening bar without the need for Hotel 41 guests to venture outside.
